result.title: Modaliff: A Unified Token Diffusion Model for Any-to-Any Generation
result.summary: Any-to-any generation seeks a single model that translates flexibly among text, image, and audio, yet existing approaches either require fully aligned multimodal tuples or a shared representation that suppresses modality-specific structure. We introduce Modaliff, a novel token-based diffusion model that learns from widely available bimodal pairs while preserving each modality in its native latent sequence. Modaliff assembles conditions and targets into a unified token sequence, with per-token attributes to disambiguate token identities and role-based positional embedding to preserve each modality's internal structure across sequence layouts. This design enables a single denoiser to support diverse generation tasks without task-specific architectural changes or a shared cross-modal latent space. Beyond one-to-one generation, Modaliff supports multiple conditions either by combining single-condition predictions at inference or by lightweight finetuning on captions that jointly describe multiple inputs. Experiments across text, image, and audio show that Modaliff achieves the best fidelity among any-to-any models on most generation tasks while using substantially fewer parameters and training data.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Modaliff，一种基于 token 的扩散模型，把条件与目标拼成统一 token 序列，配合 per-token 属性与 role-based positional embedding，在保留各模态原生 latent 序列的前提下由双模态对训练，实现文本、图像、音频间的任意到任意生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其统一 token 序列布局、角色位置嵌入与「不做共享跨模态 latent」的设计，可能为 LVR 中多模态 latent 状态的组织、位置/角色编码及信息坍缩问题提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文面向生成而非推理，需进一步判断可迁移性。
